title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
source: Souree Info: Master Soundboard Reels > PCM > PCM (14-bit) (Sony L-750ESX-HFB tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16; this source is a fix of the two previous flawed sources circulated by Scott Clugston; there is another Fixed version of this source in circulation

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard composite mix with a superb upgrade, though no performance details are provided
ai_review.review: The single five‑star review praises the upgraded mix by Tim Dalton, Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller, calling it superb. No comments on the musical performance or setlist are given, so the analysis focuses on the high‑quality recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it gives a perfect rating and highlights an excellent mix; lack of show details limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review lauds the upgraded composite mix as superb; implies clear, well‑balanced sound with professional mastering.
